description.value: The study investigated whether voluntary emotion regulation in anorexia nervosa is associated with disorder-relevant costs, combining fMRI measures of ventral striatum regulation with ecological momentary assessment of rumination and affect.

spans.text: Here we investigated whether voluntary emotion regulation in AN patients comes with associated disorder-relevant costs.

description.value: The study included 35 patients with acute anorexia nervosa and 35 age-matched healthy controls.
